name: Giussano
shortDescription: Fast, low-profile Condottieri-class cruiser with the tier's biggest guns and slowest reload, plus a choice between HE and SAP on her upgraded turrets.

stats.label: Shell Types
stats.value: HE + AP stock, or AP + SAP on upgraded turrets

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 5s action, 60s cooldown, unlimited charges. Standard reset, nothing that sets Giussano apart from tech-tree cruisers at this tier.

consumables.name: Catapult Fighter
consumables.flavor: 3 charges, 100s uptime on an 80s cooldown. Her only answer to spotter planes and air strikes, no on-demand Defensive AA Fire in this kit.

torpedoMounts.label: Port
torpedoMounts.note: Fixed to this broadside, no centerline swing.

torpedoMounts.label: Starboard
torpedoMounts.note: Fixed to this broadside, no centerline swing.

strengths: 36.5 kt top speed is the fastest of any tier III cruiser, ahead of Phoenix's 35 kts, Kuma's 34.5 kts, Danae's 30 kts, and Karlsruhe's 27.5 kts
9.2 km sea detection and 5.5 km air detection both beat every other tier III cruiser (Danae 9.5/5.7 km, Kuma 9.9/5.9 km, Phoenix 10.3/6.2 km, Karlsruhe 10.5/6.3 km)
8.0 km torpedo range is the longest of any tier III cruiser, ahead of Kuma's 7 km, Danae and Karlsruhe's 6 km, and Phoenix's 5.5 km
Researching the upgraded turrets swaps HE for SAP, a real option against angled or broadside armor that most of her tier III peers don't have
152mm/53 guns hit harder per shell than the 140mm and smaller mounts most tier III cruiser peers carry
weaknesses: 15.0s main battery reload is by far the slowest of any tier III cruiser, roughly double Danae's 7.5s, Kuma's 6s, Phoenix's 7s, and Karlsruhe's 6.5s
6-40mm armor is among the thinnest at tier III, only Duguay-Trouin's 10-30mm is lighter, and both trail well behind Karlsruhe's 100mm and Kuma's 65mm max plating
Only 4 torpedo tubes total, fewer than Danae's 12, Kuma and Karlsruhe's 8 apiece
Torpedo mounts are fixed one per broadside with no centerline swing, so a torpedo run commits to a side before you fire
Only 1 upgrade slot to work with, less room to patch up any of the above
tips: Use the speed and concealment to pick your range instead of slugging it out, the slow reload loses a straight duel against every other tier III cruiser
Make every salvo count. A missed 15-second reload costs you more than it would on a faster-cycling peer
Research the upgraded turrets for SAP once you're comfortable giving up HE, it's the sharpest answer this hull has to angled targets
Commit to a broadside before opening a torpedo run, the tubes can't swing to the other side once you've picked one
Lean on the superfiring turret pairs bow-in and stern-out, all eight guns stay live in either posture

threats.reason: 6-40mm armor is the thinnest of any tier III cruiser, a close brawl goes badly fast.

threats.threat: Faster-reloading tier III cruisers at even range
threats.reason: 15.0s reload trails every other tier III cruiser, so a standing gunnery duel favors almost anyone else.

summary: Fastest and best-hidden cruiser at tier III, built to dictate range rather than out-shoot anyone in a straight fight.
Reload is the slowest at the tier by a wide margin, so this isn't a volume-of-fire ship despite carrying eight guns.
SAP becomes available on the upgraded turrets, trading HE fire chance for consistent penetration damage against broadside targets.
Torpedoes are short on tubes but reach further than any other tier III cruiser's.
playstyle.detail: Giussano is a Condottieri-class light cruiser built for speed over protection, and it shows. Her top speed and concealment both lead the tier III cruiser field, letting her set the terms of an engagement the way her thin 6-40mm plating never could in a straight brawl. The eight-gun broadside hits hard per shell, but a 15-second reload means she's rarely winning a standing gunnery duel against faster-cycling peers. Researching the upgraded turrets adds SAP to the loadout, a real tool against angled armor once you're willing to give up HE's fire chance. Play her at range, pick shots carefully, and use the speed to be somewhere else by the time return fire arrives.
